constraints: If rangeObj contains multiple cells, the border is applied to the range as a whole (unlike VP SET CELL STYLE, which applies borders to each cell individually).
If a style sheet has already been applied to the range, VP SET BORDER overrides its previously applied border settings.

params.name: rangeObj
params.description: Range of cells where the border style will be applied

params.name: borderStyleObj
params.description: Object defining the border line color and style

params.name: borderPosObj
params.description: Object defining where the border line is applied (all/left/top/right/bottom/outline/inside/innerHorizontal/innerVertical)
